To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a simple nonlinear circuit model of the scattering antenna with corona is able to predict the time of corona onset, the shape of the antenna current waveform and the amplitude of this waveform to within a factor two, and that corona has the main effect of injecting a sharp spike in antenna base current waveform.
the transient response of an antenna with corona can be predicted with reasonable accuracy using a transmission-line circuit model.
the air breakdown on a monopole is modeled as a sharp current spike at the antenna base and the antenna transient response is modeled by an RC circuit.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the transient electromagnetic response of antennas to an incident step-function pulse.
the transient response of antennas in the presence of corona.
the study of nonlinear circuit models of antennas in the presence of air breakdown.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the circuit model developed is an excellent model for predicting the transient response of an antenna with corona.
the air breakdown phenomenon has no significant effect on the antenna response.
the transient circuit model is a useful tool for predicting the time when air-breakdown will occur, the general shape, amplitude and phase of the antenna response.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a simple and effective model for predicting the transient response of an antenna to a step-function excitation.
the circuit model of the corona antenna is a useful tool for studying the transient response of antennas in air breakdown conditions.
a simple transmission-line circuit is adequate for modeling the antenna and the air breakdown effects.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the effects of air-breakdown on antenna response can be modeled using a simple circuit model.

the transient behavior of a scattering antenna can be modeled using a simple circuit model that is easily implemented on a digital computer and that can be used to predict when and where corona effects occur.
the transient response of an antenna in a coronal environment can be modeled by a simple circuit model that includes the effects of the corona.
